data.one_liner: Rive animation support and wrappers for the Flame game engine.
data.what_it_does: Adds support for Rive animations to your Flame games. It provides wrappers and components to be used inside Flame.
use_when: You are building a game with the Flame engine and need to render Rive animations
You want to use Rive components directly inside your Flame game components and loops
avoid_when: You are not using the Flame game engine
You only need standard Flutter UI widgets instead of game engine components
strengths: Seamless integration between Rive and Flame
Provides game-ready components and wrappers for animations
weaknesses: Requires using the Flame game engine ecosystem
Limited documentation inside the provided materials
